image.name: bitcoin-knots
image.description: [Bitcoin Knots](https://bitcoinknots.org/) can be used as a desktop client for regular payments or as a full node server utility for merchants and other payment services.

changelog.desc: Make Wayland default disable with PIXELFLUX_WAYLAND=false.

volumes.desc: Users home directory in the container, stores all data.

ports.desc: Bitcoin Knots desktop gui HTTP, must be proxied.

image.title: Bitcoin-knots
image.setup_instructions:
The application can be accessed at:

* https://yourhost:3001/

>[!WARNING]
>This container is intended to run as a full Bitcoin node for the network, using it as a wallet is dangerous unless you really know what you are doing. Even momentary accidental exposure of this container can completely compromise a stored wallet.

snippets.docker_compose:
---
services:
  bitcoin-knots:
    image: ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/bitcoin-knots:latest
    container_name: bitcoin-knots
    environment:
      - PUID=1000
      - PGID=1000
      - TZ=Etc/UTC
    volumes:
      - /path/to/bitcoin-knots/config:/config
    ports:
      - 3000:3000
      - 3001:3001
      - 8333:8333
    restart: unless-stopped
snippets.docker_run:
docker run -d \
  --name=bitcoin-knots \
  -e PUID=1000 \
  -e PGID=1000 \
  -e TZ=Etc/UTC \
  -p 3000:3000 \
  -p 3001:3001 \
  -p 8333:8333 \
  -v /path/to/bitcoin-knots/config:/config \
  --restart unless-stopped \
  ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/bitcoin-knots:latest
